title: top-up: babysitter review verifier
definition: Babysitter review verification (#4657): babysitter_review_verifier.ts takes the findings of requested PR reviews, asks the existing pre-PR verifier (pre_pr_verifier.ts) for per-finding verdicts through its injected deps, and decides which reviews are verified fixed; the module itself spawns nothing and runs no repository code, though the verifier pass it hands off is a read-only model run in a disposable checkout (no shell, no edit, no project settings), so it executes no repository code
